model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms evaluated across a base model and six fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," which are ordered alphabetically: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Negative log probability," using a linear scale that ranges from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with tick labels at regular intervals of 1 unit. The chart features grouped vertical bars that extend downwards from the top axis line. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a group of seven bars. As indicated by the legends, the first bar in each group is light blue, representing the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The following six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, color-coded in a gradient: Cardio (lightest beige), Gastro (light beige), Infect (light orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (dark orange/brown), and Pediatrics (darkest brown). Across all categories, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar extends the furthest down, indicating the most negative values, with its longest bar reaching approximately -26.8 in the Cardio category. The fine-tuned models exhibit shorter downward extensions; for instance, the shortest bars in the chart appear in the Infect category, where the fine-tuned models range from approximately -23.0 to -23.2. In the Cardio category, the fine-tuned models range from roughly -25.7 to -26.1. The groups are arranged alphabetically by specialty term, and the bars within each group consistently follow the order of the legend, with no specific bars visually emphasized through bolding or outlining.
